scope: File specifications and embedded/associated file views, reviewed against the locally supplied ISO 32000-2:2020 EC3 text. File path strings retain bytes; only UF, Desc and date strings use the shared PDF text-string decoder. AF is an association view, not a profile validator or a content activation request.

requirements.status: implemented for inert library views and bounded payload reads
requirements.gaps: Annotation attachment discovery, collection and encrypted-payload models, MIME/date/associated-file conformance validation, checksum verification, streaming extraction, authoring and CLI/host/viewer integration remain open. Names/URLs never cause IO; permission flags remain a host policy distinct from stream authentication.
